description: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs line 371, 381; ban.rs line 165-166; space.rs (multiple); crate-jmap-mail-server/src/submission.rs line 804: pattern 'UTCDate::from(now_utc_string().as_str())' and 'expires_str.as_str() <= now.as_str()'. The now_utc_string() returns a String; calling .as_str() on it borrows the temporary. This works but is unnecessarily verbose. UTCDate::from should accept impl AsRef<str> or &str directly; if it does, 'UTCDate::from(now_utc_string())' would suffice. If it currently only accepts &str, 'let now = now_utc_string(); UTCDate::from(&now)' is idiomatic. Similarly, 'expires_str.as_str() <= now.as_str()' should be 'expires_str.as_ref() <= now.as_str()' or just compare the String directly.
title: now_utc_string().as_str() pattern: needless borrow of temporary String
